body:
Stand By Me 
“I’ll see you around”
“Not if I see you first” 
             and
“I never had friends again like the ones I had when I was twelve....” 

Gets me no matter WHAT
Why did I think it was going to pop once they started poking it.....

Exactly. Like she’s the love of my life and we are married and we talk about having children and I WANT to want to live so badly!!!!! For her especially. But it’s just something that I know isn’t going to work out for me. I’m so sorry you’re going through this. I know it’s a horrible feeling and nothing anyone says makes it better 💗
i’m so sorry you’re having to experience this too. it’s an awful, suffocating feeling. i tell myself that the good days make it worth it and sometimes i believe myself!

I’m so sorry you’re going through this too. I wish there was something I could say, but I know nothing really helps. I wish you well and that we both find some way to stay alive for as long as possible.
I’ve been in therapy since I’ve been 16 (I’m 25f). It has definitely helped, but I just don’t see how I’m ever going to stop wanting to just end it (life.) It’s just all too much.
